blind_spots_patched: Two-thirds of Q2 FY27 consolidated EBITDA growth came from a non-normal Specialty Oils windfall (₹23,262/KL on -20% volume), while pre-QIP non-fund-based bank limit utilization had reached ~88% on ₹8,520 Cr of working capital (~37% of FY26 TOI).

Flagship ACCC composite-core conductors rely on a single-source technology and core-supply tie-up with CTC Global (USA), while Jharsuguda's molten-aluminium cost edge depends on a direct sourcing agreement with Hindalco (alongside Vedanta RESTORA).

Post-IBC Diamond Power Infrastructure (DICABS) is scaling rapidly back into domestic conductors and MV/EHV cables (Q2 FY27 revenue +135% YoY; ₹3,735 Cr order book), alongside tariff-advantaged Gulf rivals (Midal Cables) and Chinese HTLS exporters.
assumptions_changed: WEAKENED: Q2 FY27 profit surge (PAT ₹447 Cr, +77.8% YoY; OPM 10%–11%) reflects broad-based structural step-up led by rising premium conductor mix (50.3%) and steady TSO spreads (~₹5,943/KL).
CONFIRMED: Record combined Conductor and Cable order book above ₹15,025 Cr (₹12,025 Cr Conductors + ₹3,000 Cr Cables) with hyperscaler data-center wins and global grid reconductoring demand.
CONFIRMED: August 2026 ₹2,500 Cr QIP structurally de-risked LC acceptances and earned a CARE AA; Stable credit upgrade, with -2.34% promoter stake decline purely mechanical.
WEAKENED: U.S. export franchise (~$269M in FY26, +55% YoY) is scaling smoothly with manageable Section 232 tariff and DDP transit friction.
